_comment: Single config of the AiService. The path can be overridden with the AISERVICE_CONFIG variable. The structure mirrors AiServer (config/settings.json); string values support ${VAR} substitution from the environment.

server._comment: HTTP/WebSocket server settings. One process listens on both WebSockets on a single port: ws://host:port/camera (camera) and ws://host:port/robot (robot).

camera_ws._comment: Camera WebSocket (JSON protocol): the camera sends audio (base64 PCM), pictures (base64 JPEG), face/emotion events; the server replies mute/unmute/capture.

robot_ws._comment: Robot WebSocket (JSON protocol): the server sends audio chunks for playback (base64) and movement/emotion commands; the robot replies hb/ack. The robot microphone is disabled: audio comes only from the camera.

audio._comment: Audio stream format of the protocol. The only codec is codec_pcm=1: raw PCM int16 LE, 16 kHz/mono (matches the AiBot microphone). chunk_seconds — expected duration of one PCM chunk from the camera (1 s = 32 KB).

image._comment: Picture format of the protocol. The camera sends discrete pictures (not a video stream): codec_jpeg=1 — JPEG (binary frames [2][1][jpeg]). max_frame_bytes — safety limit for a picture size (larger pictures are dropped with a log).

recording._comment: Debug media recording (a directory relative to the service root or an absolute path; can be overridden with env RECORD_DIR). Files: *_in.wav (audio from the camera), *_out.wav (audio to the robot), *_img.jpg (pictures); names start with the reception time (us). audio_rotate_seconds — incoming audio rotation (0 = one file per session).

robot._comment: Robot voice playback settings (JSON protocol). play_chunk_seconds — duration of one PCM chunk (0.15 s = 4800 B -> ~6.4 KB as a base64 JSON message, so it stays below the robot WS client's ~8 KB receive limit). play_speed — delivery pace of the voice (1.0 = real time).

yandex._comment: Yandex Cloud SpeechKit STT: streaming recognition of the camera speech (PCM 16 kHz/mono). Credentials from the environment (${VAR}): YANDEX_API_KEY (Api-Key) + YANDEX_FOLDER_ID. stt_enabled — enable/disable recognition; the utterance result is saved next to the recording (<stamp>_in.txt).
